scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "dotnet watch --project src/Portal.Api --urls http://localhost:5080" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: dotnet build -c Release && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: dotnet test -c Release && npm --prefix web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck
